name: Ják (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ják (a crowned blue and red shield with a yellow church and a sabre) above the name JÁK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
